from: September book, night 21 (My Strength and My Song)
p1: Isaiah wrote a happy song for a day still to come. It is a song about trusting the Lord.
The song says, “I will trust, and not be afraid.” It says, “The Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song.” Jehovah is Jesus’s name from long ago. He makes us strong, and He makes us sing!
Isaiah sang, “With joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.”
p2: In Isaiah’s land, families got their water from deep wells. They pulled it up in a bucket on a rope. Jesus saves us and gives our hearts what they need, like cool water.
When you feel tired or small, sing a song about Jesus. He is your strength and your song too.
old: After all his wonderful messages, Isaiah sang a happy song of trust. It’s the song this whole week is named after!
“Heavenly Father saves me!” Isaiah sang. “I will trust in Him, and I will not be afraid.”
Isaiah knew that when Heavenly Father is with us, we don’t have to be scared. He is our strength when we feel weak, and He is our song when we feel sad.
“Heavenly Father is my strength and my song,” Isaiah sang joyfully. Even in hard times, Isaiah chose to trust instead of being afraid.
You can sing Isaiah’s song too! When something feels scary, you can remember: Heavenly Father is with me, so I will trust Him and not be afraid.
